body.heading: Find tonight's moon
paragraphs: With your adult, find the moon in the evening sky. Is it round, half, or a thin curvy smile?
Look carefully at the edges. The dark part does not disappear; it is just not lit up.

body.heading: Draw what you see
paragraphs: Draw the moon's shape big on your dark paper. Only draw the bright part you can really see.
Write the date under your drawing. You have started a moon collection.

takeaway: The moon changes its shape a little every night, like a slow, sky-sized clock.
safetyNotes: Look at the moon only in the evening with your adult; never look at the Sun.
screenFreeExtension: Draw the moon again on another night and see if its shape has changed.
